limitations: Estimated robot frequency was only 3.4 trades/day.
No tested day met the 20 trades and 90% daily win-rate target.

notes: A 90% win rate with at least 20 daily forex trades is an extreme target and usually indicates either overfitting, tiny take-profits versus large stop losses, or ignored execution costs.
The code now measures the target explicitly instead of assuming it is achievable.
Broker-grade tick data, walk-forward testing, and demo execution are required before live trading.
